t: Three mullet for the smoker.
Four bluegill. My grandkid's science fair.
A koi. Any koi. Don't ask who it's for.
Two largemouth bass for the Friday fish fry.
A peacock bass. A customer wants a picture with one.
A catfish. The uglier the better.
Two eels. Don't make it weird.
A dozen golf balls. I resell 'em to the club. Don't tell the club.
Anything over 10 pounds. I need something for the window.
Two things out of a manhole. A guy collects them. Different guy.
A snook. The real kind, not the story kind.
A grass carp from Heron Lakes. The HOA owes me money.
A python. The bounty office is buying and so am I.
Two gar. Don't ask me why. Okay, it's for a bet.
An oscar from the theme park. My nephew lost his.
Three seatrout off the pier. Restaurant downtown wants 'local.'
Two mangrove snapper. Fry night at the VFW.
A sheepshead. I want to show people the teeth.
A barracuda for the wall. A mean-looking one.
A mahi. The real kind. Not the frozen kind Fintastic sells.
A blackfin tuna. Sushi guy owes me a favor. Now I owe him one.
Something from the Marlowe Tower pool. Anything. Just to make a point.
